'''Dors Stelikag''' aka "Moustache" aka "Stelig" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] low-rent [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] working for [[Nuso Esva]] on [[Poln Major]]. He organized a [[Riot in Whitestone City|riot]] that commenced a [[Battle for Poln Major|skirmish]] against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] forces.
